stem:
Meera is making a chart of the Solar System for her school science exhibition in Jaipur. She lists the planets in increasing distance from the Sun and groups them as inner and outer planets.

Which list shows the correct order of the eight planets from the Sun?

options.text: Mercury, Mars, Venus, Earth, Jupiter, Saturn, Neptune, Uranus
Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune
Venus, Mercury, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Uranus, Saturn, Neptune
Mercury, Venus, Mars, Earth, Saturn, Jupiter, Uranus, Neptune

teacher.key_rationale: The correct order of the eight planets in increasing distance from the Sun is Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, with the first four as inner planets and the last four as outer gaseous planets. Only option B gives this full sequence; the other options swap adjacent planets or reverse the inner planet order.
